PX-R1.name: Actual D.Fin0
PX-R1.statement_used: For every IsCO O R and every actual IsPt lift rho of D.rbar, the O-algebra adjoined by all entry monomials of full weight0 is finite over O.
PX-R1.supplier_frontier: SymplecticFourImageDense, as used exactly in AX10

PX-R2.name: Actual D.NoEnd
PX-R2.statement_used: Every actual algebraic-valued EPt with all matrices block diagonal has its {0,2} block matrix span strictly smaller than M2(K).
PX-R2.supplier_frontier: SymplecticFourImageDense, as used exactly in AX10

PX-R3.name: Actual D.AllIrr D.RigidAt
PX-R3.statement_used: Every irreducible actual EPt rho and every actual PtIn over K[epsilon] reducing to rho has derivative [X,rho] with X in sp4(K).
PX-R3.supplier_frontier: rigSp4_alt and its exact local Hodge and global adjoint prerequisites remain; this component does not equate a generic rigidity package with this assertion without its installation.
